Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote, US

Product engineering at Descript means owning outcomes, not just tickets — you'll take a problem from a rough idea to a shipped, measured result, working closely with product, design, and the rest of engineering along the way. We organize around a few teams, each responsible for a distinct part of the product:

- Editor: owns our video editor. Help make traditionally complex video-editing workflows simpler, craft cutting-edge AI into practical creative tools, and build on our vision of turning a text-editor for video into a tool that puts video in everyone's communication toolkit.

- Growth & Monetization: owns onboarding and activation, growth loops and in-product experiments, plans and pricing, checkout, billing, and AI credits. Help turn visitors into customers and customers into revenue.

- Media: owns upload, transcription, diarization, alignment, drive-wide search, playback, rendering, and export (including the engine we're rewriting in Rust ). Help make media fast to bring in, easy to find, instant to play, and reliable to export.

- Agent: owns Underlord, Descript’s AI co-editor. Build the representations, tools, harness, evals, and feedback loops that let it reason about video projects, make edits, and check its work. Help people and agents collaborate naturally, whether in the editor or through our API and MCP.

- Identity & Access (aka TACO): owns login, authentication and authorization, account settings, and project organization, plus the enterprise layer of workspaces, SSO/SCIM, governance, and audit logs. Help individuals become teams, and teams scale into enterprises, with the trust and security to go all in.

Regardless of your team you’ll have the opportunity to design thoughtful full-stack systems that work reliably and deliver value to new and existing users.

What You’ll Do

- Own meaningful product surfaces end to end. Take problems from definition through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and maintenance. Improve core Editor workflows, shape the self-serve journey from signup through renewal, or help make Underlord more sentient.

- Shape the product, not just the implementation. Partner with Product and Design to propose better interactions, expose constraints, choose the right metrics, and find simpler paths to user outcomes.

- Build ambitious full-stack systems with care. Create responsive, reliable experiences. Stretch from TypeScript and React to NodeJS and Temporal to first and third party integrations to get the job done.

- Improve how the team learns and ships. Form hypotheses, instrument your work, release incrementally, and read results honestly. Strengthen the tooling, standards, tests, observability, and release practices that help the team move quickly without compromising quality.

- Raise the team’s technical ambition. Provide architectural direction, thoughtful reviews, mentoring, and clear human writing.

What You Bring

Required:

- You have 5+ years of experience building and shipping customer-facing products, including end-to-end features that measurably improved user or business outcomes.

- You effectively leverage agents to multiply your impact and think critically about how to better harness AI in your work.

- You’ve owned features/experiments end to end, from planning through launch, and leveraged analytics and metrics to evaluate impact.

- You orient quickly in unfamiliar systems by exploring and asking thoughtful questions to both your teammates and agents.

- You care about how software feels and notice when the technically correct result is still wrong for the user.

- You create clarity in ambiguous work and can navigate (and simplify!) significant product and technical complexity.

- You validate your work rigorously through focused reproductions, logs, tests, and other evidence rather than trusting that the output looks right.

Experience that helps:

- Similar Products: Work on an editor, media product, creative tool, or payment system (like Stripe).

- Our Stack: TypeScript, HTML/CSS, React, Redux, Node.js, API design, Temporal Workflows, and SQL. But we obviously live in a post stack world. We just rewrote our media engine in Rust. None of us knows Rust.

- Crafting with AI: Building an agent or experimenting with media-generation models.

- Experimentation/Analytics Experience: We like people who know how to measure their success through experimentation and product analytics.

- Intricacies of Video: Shaders, graphics rendering, audio/visual effects, and media formats.

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

Check out this Loom video for more details:
We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.
What this role actually is
You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:
• Whether the response makes sense

- Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

- Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

- Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.
What you'll be doing

- Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

- Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

- Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

- Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

- Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

- Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"
We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

- Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

- Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

- Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

- Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.
Who you are

- Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

- Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python

- Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

- Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

- Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line

- Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

- Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

- High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

- Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

- Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

- Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

- Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well

- Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat

- Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

Sobre Creai
En Creai , nos especializamos en aprovechar el poder de la inteligencia artificial y el aprendizaje automático para transformar negocios. Nuestra misión es ayudar a los clientes a reducir costos, aumentar la eficiencia y desbloquear nuevas oportunidades mediante soluciones de IA de vanguardia.
Descripción del Puesto
Como Full Stack Software Engineer para IA, tu rol central ya no es escribir código línea por línea, sino dirigir, supervisar y validar el trabajo de agentes de IA generativa y agentica que construyen soluciones escalables y de alto impacto. Usarás tu dominio técnico y de negocio para diseñar la arquitectura correcta, definir el qué y el por qué de cada solución, delegar la ejecución táctica a la IA , y ejercer el criterio necesario para juzgar, corregir y aprobar sus outputs antes de que lleguen a producción.

Serás responsable de entregar funcionalidades completas de complejidad alta con velocidad y calidad, asegurando que la velocidad que da la IA no comprometa la estabilidad, seguridad ni mantenibilidad del sistema. Colaborarás con otros ingenieros y equipos multidisciplinarios para integrar servicios, pipelines y modelos, fortaleciendo los estándares técnicos y las prácticas de supervisión de IA dentro de Creai .

Este Puesto Exige

- Orquestación de Desarrollo: Dirigir a agentes de IA para generar funciones y servicios, revisando y refactorizando el código resultante para garantizar que sea limpio, funcional, mantenible y esté alineado con la arquitectura del sistema. Escribir código propio cuando la tarea lo requiera, especialmente en piezas críticas o ambiguas donde el criterio humano marca la diferencia.

- Validación de Calidad: Diseñar la estrategia de pruebas (smoke tests, integración, end to end etc) y delegar su automatización a IA, verificando que la cobertura generada realmente valide los casos de negocio relevantes y no solo los casos evidentes.

- Gestión de Datos: Definir la arquitectura de pipelines batch de datos y usar IA para acelerar su construcción, auditando personalmente la validación de schemas y la coherencia entre orígenes y destinos, dado que los errores de datos introducidos por IA suelen ser sutiles y costosos de detectar tarde.

- Modelado y Entrenamiento Inicial: Supervisar el entrenamiento de modelos estándar y el ajuste de hiperparámetros —ejecutado manualmente o asistido por IA— bajo la guía del equipo de IA, evaluando de forma crítica si los resultados obtenidos responden al problema de negocio planteado.

- Gestión de Incidentes: Usar IA para acelerar el triage y diagnóstico de incidentes, manteniendo la responsabilidad final de clasificar, comunicar y resolver runbooks comunes, y aportando criterio en los casos que la IA no puede resolver por sí sola.

- Seguridad del Software: Usar IA para ejecutar threat checklists y sugerir parches, validando y priorizando esas recomendaciones con criterio propio antes de aplicarlas, evitando falsos positivos o negativos que la IA no puede juzgar por contexto de negocio.

- Definición de Criterios de Calidad: Definir criterios de aceptación y Definition of Done para las tareas —incluyendo qué se considera un output de IA aceptable—, asegurando entregables completos, correctos y alineados al problema real de negocio, no solo funcionalmente correctos.

- Diseño de Flujos con IA: Diseñar prompts, contexto y flujos de trabajo reutilizables (plantillas, snippets, agentes configurados) para copilotos e IA generativa, elevando la productividad del equipo y estableciendo buenas prácticas de uso de IA dentro de Creai .

Requisitos

Experiencia Técnica:

- Bases sólidas en fundamentos de ingeniería de software (estructuras de datos, patrones de diseño, principios de arquitectura): son la base del criterio necesario para evaluar código y soluciones generadas por IA.

- Experiencia práctica (mínimo 1–2 años) en desarrollo backend y frontend, ya sea escribiendo código directamente o dirigiendo su generación con herramientas de IA.

- Experiencia usando agentes de IA (por ejemplo, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) dentro de flujos de trabajo reales de desarrollo.

- Experiencia con pipelines de CI/CD y pruebas unitarias.

- Conocimientos de bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales.

- Familiaridad con servicios en la nube y herramientas de control de versiones (Git).

- Experiencia inicial en proyectos con aprendizaje automático o IA aplicada.

Habilidades Profesionales:

- Criterio técnico para juzgar cuándo confiar en un output de IA y cuándo cuestionarlo, corregirlo o rediseñarlo por completo.

- Autonomía en la resolución de tareas de complejidad media, incluyendo la orquestación de múltiples herramientas de IA.

- Colaboración efectiva dentro de equipos multidisciplinarios.

- Interés en prácticas de DevSecOps y en el uso de IA para mejorar la productividad.

Beneficios

- 🚀 Oportunidades de crecimiento: Plan de carrera y mentoría con expertos en IA y tecnología.

- 🚀 Ambiente de startup dinámico y flexible: Autonomía para tomar decisiones y proponer ideas, con un enfoque en resultados en lugar de horas trabajadas.

Get to know us better
CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

- Act to deliver.

- Disrupt to grow.

- Team up to win.

The project and the team
You will join a team co-developing a unified, cloud-based network security management platform from a leading cybersecurity vendor. You will be building and maintaining the User Interfaces for specialized automation software running within that platform.
As the software keeps expanding and becoming a fully-fledged product, we're looking for another Senior Frontend Engineer to help build what's next. It is as much a product engineering challenge as a technical one.
Other things to know:

- The team consists of Software and DevOps engineers who share strong ownership of code and product quality

- AI tools are part of the daily workflow

- This is a frontend-focused role

- We are a distributed, fully remote team

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we'll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.
Your role
As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

- Wrapping complex enterprise network security configuration converters into clear, fast and reliable interactive workflows, with validated forms and editable mapping tables

- Designing and building multi-step micro-apps and shared UI libraries in a React and TypeScript monorepo

- Modelling long-running, asynchronous workflows in the UI: progress, polling, cancel, retry and recovery after a page reload

- Evolving shared frontend foundations: pure TypeScript workflow state machines, micro-frontend boundaries and reusable accessible components

- Keeping the application fast on very large datasets (100k+ items), including profiling, virtualisation and performance budgets

- Writing unit, reducer, component and browser/E2E tests (Vitest, React Testing Library, Storybook, Playwright) running in CI (GitLab CI)

- Applying AI-assisted engineering practices and setting the standard for how they are used - across the entire SDLC, not only in code generation

- Contributing to architecture and design decisions as the solution scales in different dimensions

- Proposing and helping ship your own ideas for improving the product, beyond your core delivery work

Do we have a match?
As a Senior Software Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

- Strong, 7+ years professional experience in similar roles

- Experience building and maintaining software products for external customers

- Languages / Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React (micro-frontends)

- Build & monorepo tooling: Vite, pnpm, Turborepo, Storybook, Oxlint
